lesson.title: What's a rational number?
lesson.html: Any number you can write as A/B where A and B are integers and B ≠ 0. The value of a rational number is the quotient of its little division problem.

lesson.title: Conversions
lesson.html: Decimal → percent: ×100. Percent → decimal: ÷100. Fraction → decimal: divide top by bottom.

lesson.title: Fraction operations
lesson.html:
Add/subtract: find a common denominator.
Multiply: straight across.
Divide: Keep, Change, Flip.

list.q: What is the value of a rational number?
list.a: The quotient of its little division problem
w: The product of top and bottom
list.why: A fraction IS a division problem: numerator ÷ denominator.

list.q: Multiplying decimals: where does the decimal go?
list.a: As many places in from the right as there were place holders in the original numbers
list.why: Multiply as if there are no decimals, then count the place holders.

list.a: Make the divisor a whole number and move the dividend's decimal the same number of places
w: Move only the dividend's decimal left
list.why: Then divide as usual and bring the decimal straight up.
